title: StructureOverhaul
description: Structures, but better. And by a lot...
body:
**🏛️ Better Vanilla Structures**

Are you tired of exploring a world where you keep coming across the same small and predictable structures?
This data pack reworks the basic structures of Minecraft and replaces them with larger, more detailed, and more interesting versions, all in the original style.

The goal is to make exploration satisfying again - Buildings should feel like real places worth discovering, not just places to quickly loot.

*****
⚒️ CurseForge version:
[Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/structureoverhaul)
*****

**✨ Features**
- Complete replacements for selected vanilla structures
- Bigger layouts with more rooms, variation, and atmosphere
- Designed to feel vanilla-friendly, not out of place
- Fully compatible with survival gameplay
- No new blocks or items required

*****

**🏗️ Currently Reworked Structures**
- 🌴 Jungle Temple – expanded ruins with more depth and challenge
- 🏜️ Desert Pyramid – larger tombs with improved interiors
- 🏹 Pillager Outpost – more imposing and interesting outposts
- More structures may be added in future updates.

*****

**⚙️ Compatibility**
- Created for Minecraft 1.20.1
- May work on other versions, but this is not guaranteed
- Works as a Data Pack (no mods required)
- Should be compatible with most mods and modpacks unless they also replace the same structures
